messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment started -> env=sandbox, initiator=@olivia, tag=v1.3.7-hotfix-alpha, commit=9a1b2c3, pipeline=build|push|deploy|smoke. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/patches/3214 :rocket:
olivia: kicking off smoke now, leaving initial traffic at 10% and feature flag `new-tokenizer` OFF for baseline comparison. will post quick checks. :eyes:
rajesh: quick q — any DB or schema changes in this roll?
olivia: no schema changes. config + tokenizer binary and a tiny perf tweak. no migrations.
sre-oncall: watching p50/p95 and error rate. threshold alerts: p50>120ms for 2m or error-rate>1%. ping if you want me to pause.
deploy-bot: 10% rollout completed, health checks OK, no crashes. logs show normal startup.
olivia: smoke tests passing on sample corpus, outputs look aligned. tagging as "smoke-pass". :thumbsup:
kevin: seeing a small uptick in tokenization warnings in logs around 9:17pm, low volume but flagging: `TokenizeWarning: unknown_char_seq`. attaching snippet: `ctx=tokenizer.py:142 sample_id=af3b`
rajesh: hm, probably a fallback path. can we hold at 10% and flip `new-tokenizer` on for 30% to get more coverage?
olivia: good call. bumping to 30% now. will enable only for traffic with header `X-Exp-Group: beta` so we can trace.
deploy-bot: traffic increased to 30% for tag=v1.3.7-hotfix-alpha. rolling metrics collection enabled.
sre-oncall: seeing a 15% spike in p95 for a short window starting +00:18 since deploy, investigating correlation with tokenizer warnings.
kevin: digging into logs, looks like a specific input pattern trips the fallback. capturing sample set and opening an infra trace.
olivia: let's keep at 30% for 30 minutes, if stable we'll promote. please escalate if error-rate climbs.
(deploy window passes ~35m)
deploy-bot: Alert: p95 exceed threshold for 3m (measured 220ms), error-rate 1.6% over last 5m. Auto-safeguard kicked in. Initiating rollback to tag=v1.3.6 as configured in policy `rollback-on-latency`.
sre-oncall: acknowledged — initiating controlled rollback. disabling 3rd-party tokenizer rollouts and restoring previous binary.
deploy-bot: Rollback started -> target tag=v1.3.6, steps=drain|switch|verify.
sre-oncall: rollback completed, post-rollback health checks green, p50/p95 back to baseline.
olivia: rolling back feature flag as well and opening ticket RED-1234 with samples and logs. thanks team.
kevin: saved traces and samples to the ticket, will follow up with a patch for the tokenizer fallback rules. :wrench:
rajesh: thanks for quick reactions. will re-run local fuzzing against the sample set before next attempt.
deploy-bot: Deployment finished: status=rolled_back, rolled_to=v1.3.6, duration=00:37:00, initiated_by=auto-safeguard. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/1918203345/logs
olivia: follow-up plan: revert runtime tweak, add extra unit tests for the unknown char path, and schedule a canary redeploy after fixes. I'll put a short RFC in #eng-releases.
